options.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.

steps.player: Can you heal me? I'm injured.

steps.text: If the player is already full Hitpoints:
The teoki whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.

steps.player: The egg that was living at the top of the temple!

steps.npc: Yes, I noticed the tourist had an egg with him... I didn't realise it had a name...
Well... it's an egg, iknami. If it's broken, then there isn't much you can do about that.

steps.player: I'm not giving up without at least trying first.

steps.npc: I see... Well, I don't think I can help you, iknami, but good luck.

options.text: What are you doing out here?

steps.player: What are you doing out here?

steps.npc: I am Jatziri, one of the seven teoki in service to Ralos. Along with my counterpart from the Sect of Ranul, I am responsible for the temple of Tal Teok.

steps.text: Having completed Twilight's Promise but not The Heart of Darkness:

steps.npc: That I would like to know myself. Tecuani left to attend to business elsewhere in the kingdom, but is yet to return.
It could well be. It is being looked into, but given the recent events at the Teomat, there are other matters that also require attention.
Tecuani was unfortunately misled by the traitor Metzli. He joined with her cult along with a few other members of the Sect of Ranul.
Don't be. He is no servant of Ranul. He will die the death of a traitor. Once that happens, a more fitting replacement will be chosen.

steps.player: So for now you're here alone? Does that make the work harder?

steps.npc: Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. That said, there was a small issue recently when some tourist decided to move in and make it their home.

steps.text: If the player has not completed Scrambled!:

steps.npc: I'll need to handle that at some point, but they don't seem to be causing much trouble, so it is thankfully not a pressing concern.

steps.text: If the player has completed Scrambled!:

steps.npc: However, the problem resolved itself in an unexpected way when he sadly fell from atop the temple steps. It seems it was a freak accident.

steps.player: Yes, I was actually there to witness it myself. It was horrible.

steps.npc: Let us hope he can at least now find peace with Ranul.
Tal Teok is thankfully one of the easier holy sites to look after. However, there is a small issue at the moment in that some tourist has decided to move in and make it their home.

steps.player: Yes, along with his egg, [egg name], but there's a bit of a problem! [Egg name]'s broken!

steps.npc: Timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
